messages:
Maya Singh: HarborTech reached out - they say April overage looks unusually high after a migration. Invoice INV-2026-0921 total $3,880; customer says expected ~2k. Can someone review?

Carlos Diaz: Pulling usage. Looks like a one-off spike: 1.2M tokens on 2026-04-18 due to a test job that replayed 6x. I see logs referencing job run id run_88f.

Maya Singh: Customer claims the job was a mistaken replay on our side during onboarding help. They asked for a goodwill refund for the incremental overage above expected 2k.

Olivia Park: OK — propose goodwill credit $1,880 (invoice minus expected 2k). We usually do goodwill credits under $2k with manager approval. @Carlos can you confirm cause and add audit memo?

Carlos Diaz: Confirmed root cause: onboarding replay; eng ticket ENG-2044 created. Will add ledger note root_cause=onboard_replay run_id=run_88f.

Olivia Park: I approve $1,880 goodwill credit to be applied to next invoice. Create credit note CN-1999, acct_code=6543, tag=GOODWILL_HARBOR_0426. Please mark non-recurring.

Carlos Diaz: Creating credit: 
```
/create-credit --customer acct_harbor_12 --amount 1880 --reason "goodwill credit - onboarding replay" --acct_code 6543 --apply_next_invoice true
```

billing-bot: Credit created CN-1999 amount $1,880 status=applied_to_next_invoice. Ledger note appended: "goodwill credit per CS request; ENG-2044 created; audit_tag GOODWILL_HARBOR_0426". Posted to accounting queue GL 1200/6543.

Maya Singh: Notified customer and sent CN-1999 PDF and short memo for their AP. CS-bot logged customer ack: "thanks, appreciate it".

Olivia Park: Closing. Keep copy in billing adjustments and reference ENG-2044 for remediation follow-up.
thread_summary: HarborTech billed for large overage caused by onboarding job replay; finance issued $1,880 goodwill credit CN-1999 to apply to next invoice and opened ENG-2044 for remediation.
